Market today: The market mood is cautious, driven by inflation fears and a global bond sell-off. This environment typically pressures growth-oriented tech and chip names, which make up most of your book.

Your holdings: SOXL is down a brutal -58.06% and SPAL is down -39.48%. Both are leveraged ETFs, meaning drawdowns are amplified, especially on margin. SMH (-13.17%) and QQQI (-3.12%) are also near their trim stops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on bond yields and any further signs of inflation. The 'shakeout' in early-stage AI could also signal broader tech weakness.

Bottom line: With significant exposure to leveraged tech on margin, managing risk in your deeply negative positions is paramount in this uncertain macro climate.
plays: Act on SOXL and SPAL: Their deep losses (-58.06%, -39.48%) and leveraged nature on margin demand immediate attention. Consider significant trims or exits.
Respect stops on SMH (540) and QQQI (52). Trim these positions if they hit their levels to protect capital.
Watch SOXS (entry 51.55-51.5, stop 51.2) as a potential short-term hedge against further semiconductor weakness, given the AI shakeout concerns.
